RESEARCH BRIEFING

23 Nov 2026

Global Valve and Actuator Market Outlook 2026

In partnership with the British Valve and Actuator Association

Growth moderates in 2027 as the energy shock persists. Global valve demand growth is forecast to slow to 3.7% in 2027 from 5.0% in 2026. High energy prices and tighter monetary policy are expected to constrain the industrial recovery, particularly in the first half of 2027. But growing AI-related demand is providing support to the valves demand outlook.

Fill in the form to download a sample of Global Valve and Actuator Market Outlook 2026 report. Some of our key findings include:

Asia Pacific is among the faster-growing regions in 2027, as AI-related goods demand boosts growth prospects for South Korea and Taiwan.

In the US, the data-centre boom and investment incentives make the US more resilient to higher energy costs and tighter policy.

Europe returns to growth in 2027, with German fiscal stimulus and strong economic growth prospects in Spain providing the main support, but France and the UK are held back by subdued economic conditions and weak end-use demand.

The Middle East & Africa is forecast to be the fastest-growing region in 2027 after a fall in 2026, but risks are clearly to the downside if the war persists.

Our alternative scenarios show how much hangs on AI and fiscal policy. An AI boom would be extremely beneficial for valve demand, through data-centre construction, cooling systems and machinery manufacturing. A fiscal crisis, with investor concerns about Japan spreading to other economies, would be a significant headwind.
